messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — PR ready for hotfix, need 2x approvals before 00:15 UTC cutoff (~45m). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1987. Short description: kv cache retention bump to reduce cold-start misses. Please ping if you can be second eye.

Devon: Pinging @Alex @Tim — can one of you take a quick look? If this is just a retention tweak we should be fine to ship in the window.

Alex: On it, will review in ~10m.

Tim: Quick Q — does this require any runtime migration or rollout steps? If so, call that out.

Maria: No schema changes. It's a retention config bump only. Smoke test steps below:
```
# quick smoke
git checkout main
git pull
git fetch origin pull/1987/head:hotfix-1987
make smoke-test TARGET=kv
```
All tests pass locally for me.

Devon: If smoke tests pass I'm happy to be second approver.

Olivia: LGTM — one tiny nit: change "cache warmup" log to "kv cache warmup" for clarity. Not blocking. :thumbsup:

Alex: LGTM. Verified smoke tests green on my laptop. Rebased and resolved the tiny conflict.

SRE Bot: Deploy window reminder — cutoff in 30m. Auto-merge remains blocked until 2 approvals are present.

Maria: Thanks — I'll wait for Devon's approval then merge and cut the tag. I'll notify infra after merge.

Devon: Approved. second LGTM. Merging when CI finishes.

Deploy Bot: PR #1987 merged by Maria. Tag created: hotfix-2026-03-17. Rollout scheduled to canary in 10m.

Maria: Thanks everyone — keeping an eye on canary. If we see regression I'll roll back immediately.
